current_prompt.body:
READ the provided load test results table.
ANALYZE the average response time, percentile latencies (P95, P99), throughput, error rate, CPU usage, memory usage, and database connections across the various load levels.
IDENTIFY the saturation point where throughput plateaus.
DETERMINE the primary bottleneck resource causing performance degradation.
EXPLAIN the reasons for throughput decrease at 1000 concurrent users.
RECOMMEND the maximum concurrent users for the system.
PROVIDE specific scaling recommendations.
